LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Formul: Available = account total − reserved. Amounts are integer minor units from the live funded ledger (100 minor = 1 silver), always shown with two decimals.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Source: Source: the live funded ledger (not a frozen economic account). Unpaid wages, quotes and contract amounts are forecasts and never count as balance; only real settlements move it.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Sampli: Read at this refresh and updated with the page's 60-tick refresh; it is a live figure and may differ from the plan's sampling time.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.NoPlan: No shadow-plan sample yet: the account numbers still show, while the reserve target and top-up state await planning.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Window: Budget window: the next {0} day(s) (not every living item is costed yet).
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Object: Reserve target {0}: necessary living cost minus effective coverage.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Trigge: Start line {0} = min(reserve target, low water {1} + emergency {2}); top-up begins only below it.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Exit: Once started, top-up continues until the reserve target {0}; below the start line a shortfall may remain without seeking work.
LanguageData.PC_PEA.Needs.Planning.Account.Tip.Decisi: Current decision: {0} · reason: {1}. Top-up means income is needed; actual job seeking also depends on drafting, eating, sleeping, capabilities, work hours and vacancies.
